arms.Q0_FULL_SCAN: examine every atom warrant and every edge, decide by fixpoint over full structure; no index
arms.Q1_INDEXED: production ExtractionIndex + production closure over indexed adjacency; strongest-parent arm; snapshot-bound rebuild charged on every structural update
arms.Q2_QUOTIENT: partition refinement by (atom_type, warrant signature, quarantined) with s,t singleton-protected; counting-block quotient edges; negatives refuted exactly at quotient level; positives confirmed by minimal concrete witness reopen; build+maintenance+reopen charged
arms.Q3_SUBSPACE: exact query region ungated_closure(s) intersect backward-plain(t) via production incident adjacency, induced subfield, production closure; production impact_cone is forward-only and dependency-filtered so it serves the revocation/reopen path instead; parent = program slicing / dependency closure (KS-T09)
arms.Q4_PROBE: probe API reveals one atom's outgoing postings per probe; cheap per-channel summary charged; non-oracle rarest-channel-first order (parent-owned selectivity); early stop on SUPPORTED admission (monotonicity); negatives exhaust frontier
arms.Q4_SHUFFLE_NULL: mandatory shuffle-equal-n control: identical probe machinery, same per-task probe budget as Q4 consumed, next probe chosen uniformly at random from the live frontier; Q4 adaptive value is registered ONLY on the Q4-vs-null margin; if the null reproduces Q4 the effect is budget selectivity, never an FQ-2 positive
arms.Q5_COMPOSED: quotient + cone + adaptive probe; quotient-level negative refutation; first-admission positive stop + one concrete confirmation verifier call
